cross_item_rule: No rule generalised. The only elimination that fired at all was ENTAILMENT NESTING - one option being a strict special case of another, so it cannot be the unique key - and it fired exactly once (item 18). Everything else was blocked by the same property, which is the batch's dominant design: 14 of the 24 items (1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 16, 18, 19, 20, 22, 23, 24 and to a lesser extent 9) hold all four options inside ONE sentence frame, varying a single clause, so every option performs the identical rhetorical act and satisfies the stem equally - the axis the stem names is not the axis the options differ along. The four vocabulary items (8, 11, 12, 14) and four completion items (2, 15, 17, 21) offer no frame to break at all. Two weaker tells were noticed but were NOT treated as eliminations because I would not defend them to someone holding the passage: a familiar-field-fact pull on 7 (open review slows decisions) and 19 (legumes fix nitrogen), and a measurement-validity pull on 13 - each names the likeliest key without making any other option illegal.
shared_frames: Four frame families, none of which leaks across items. (a) Mirror-pair frames: 1 (recall vs reproduction) and 4 (gravestones vs boulders x larger vs smaller) are both clean 2x2 grids over two named entities - knowing the design tells you the key is a cell, not which cell. (b) Numeric/residual frames: 6 (fraction of the gap + residual cause) and 18/24 (structure, differing only in the closing move). (c) Paired-text rebuttal frames: 1, 7, 9, 13, 16, 19 all ask how Text 2 bears on Text 1, and all offer a menu of confounds; 9, 13, 16 and 19 each include one measurement-artifact option and one prior-trend/alternative-driver option, but the recurrence is a distractor convention, not a key convention - it does not let one item answer another. (d) Bare-lexical items: 2, 15, 17, 21 (completion) and 8, 11, 12, 14 (word-in-context) carry no propositional content in the options at all, which is the strongest clean shape in the set. No item helped me answer any other item.
